notes.title: Death Roads: Tournament is out now!
notes.content:
[h2]Death Roads: Tournament is finally out in a full-release version! [/h2]

Get the game on launch discount [b](15% off)[/b] and take part in the most dangerous race this year! 

Thank you, folks, for all your feedback! With it, we’ve been able to rework a lot of balance and difficulty issues. We’ve also added a bunch of new stuff that hopefully will improve your game experience and let you blow up your foes in new, exciting ways.

[previewyoutube=i4ihY4iBvQo;full][/previewyoutube]

Be sure to drop your feedback and join us on Discord to discuss it - [url=https://discord.gg/acb8Y9tUtK]DISCORD SERVER[/url]

Happy playing!

notes.title: Death Roads: Tournament leaves Early Access soon!
notes.content:
We're revving up and leaving the pit stop! [b]Prepare for the grand premiere of Death Roads: Tournament as we bid farewell to Early Access on Steam.[/b] Don’t worry; Prologue is still there to play for free! Check out the new trailer of the main game.

[previewyoutube=suZmGcE-AWs;full][/previewyoutube]

On [b]November 15th[/b], we're officially saying goodbye to Early Access and hitting the gas for the big launch. Death Roads: Tournament has come a long way and has improved significantly, all thanks to you. Your support during Early Access has been nothing short of amazing. 

Thank you for checking the prologue, and remember, the race is far from over!
